name: Shimmering Frond
summary: In the Oracle Glade, a strange plant casts a twisting, shimmering aura. Its fronds come from a species native to the Swamp of Sorrows, far across the Great Sea.

sections.title: A Specimen from Afar
sections.body: A radiant plant grows among the trees near the Oracle Glade. Its aura pulses, and its fronds shimmer in the woodland light. Denalan, who tends planters beside Lake Al'Ameth, recognizes the leaves as belonging to a species from the Swamp of Sorrows in the Eastern Kingdoms. How seeds from that distant marsh crossed the Great Sea and took root on Teldrassil remains a mystery. Denalan is growing specimens in his own soil to study them.

faq.q: Where does the Shimmering Frond come from?
aliases: where do i get shimmering frond
faq.answer: You can gather the frond from a strange plant in the Oracle Glade on Teldrassil. Its leaves shimmer with a twisting, pulsing radiance in the forest light.

faq.q: Who is interested in the Shimmering Frond?
faq.answer: Denalan, a night elf naturalist conducting botanical research beside Lake Al'Ameth, wants to inspect the frond. He is interested in strange plants taking root across Teldrassil.

faq.q: What makes this plant so unusual on Teldrassil?
faq.answer: The plant comes from the Swamp of Sorrows in the Eastern Kingdoms, far across the Great Sea. Its presence on Teldrassil is unexpected because it is not native to Kalimdor or the World Tree.

faq.q: What happens after giving the frond to Denalan?
aliases: what does denalan do with it
faq.answer: Denalan plants the specimen in his planters beside Lake Al'Ameth. He tests its rapid growth and exotic properties.

angles.text: As a druid, you may find an invasive marsh plant thriving on Teldrassil's newly raised branches a curious anomaly.
As an herbalist, you can appreciate the rare resilience it took for a Swamp of Sorrows plant to cross the ocean and thrive in foreign soil.
